name: John
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: supplemental character reference sheet for a future animated desktop pet, not a finished spritesheet.
Create ONE crisp, high-resolution landscape production-reference sheet with twelve separated full-body drawings of ONLY the specified character from the 1965 The Beatles ABC television cartoon. Follow the attached historical model-sheet reproduction as the primary identity and clothing reference; the attached original running production cel is a supporting pose reference. These are identity references, not edit targets.
Layout: 4 columns x 3 rows, roomy margins, all twelve complete figures with black boots fully visible, consistent body proportions, same scale, transparent background. No grid lines, shadows, environment, writing, captions, signatures or logos.
Row 1 left to right: neutral front view; neutral three-quarter view facing screen-right; clear profile facing screen-right; rear view (the rear design is an inferred supplemental view).
Row 2: cheerful wave; running screen-left; running screen-right; airborne jump with both feet lifted and knees bent.
Row 3: waiting thoughtfully with hand near chin; crestfallen disappointed pose; excited success pose with both hands raised; playing the character's musical instrument.
Match the simple 1960s flat cel animation, clean black outlines, flat blue clothing, peach skin, solid black mop-top hair and pointed black Beatle boots. Preserve the specific model's distinctive face and hair, head-to-body ratio, and costume in EVERY pose. No photorealism, 3D, chibi redesign, round glasses, moustache, beard, Sgt Pepper outfits, Yellow Submarine 1968 design, or modern fan-art styling. Keep instruments and hands unambiguous. This is a new AI-generated supplemental asset, not a claim to be archival artwork.

Subject identity: John Lennon ONLY. In reference image 1, John is the large colored figure at lower center with hands on hips, immediately left of the John text/sketch region. In reference image 2 he is the rightmost running figure. Broad elongated rounded chin/jaw, long narrow vertical nose, sly sideways half-lidded eyes, thick black mop-top, confident posture. Blue collarless suit jacket over shirt with a narrow dark tie (NOT the turtleneck of George/Ringo). Instrument pose: right-handed electric rhythm guitar with neck extending screen-left.
